labels.wrongElement: accepted key "Aun" and error variant "Aún" marked incorrect with feedback "Тут знак наголосу не потрібен" for aún meaning todavía
labels.expectedFinding: aún meaning todavía is tonic and written with the accent; aun without accent means incluso/hasta.

labels.wrongElement: accepted variant v2 "hubieron" (noteUk claims agreement with «dos accidentes») accepted as correct for existential haber
labels.expectedFinding: Existential haber stays singular in every tense: «hubo dos accidentes», not «hubieron».

labels.wrongElement: «a las diez» has no de la mañana/de la noche and no other cue; the key accepts only "О 22:00" and marks "О 10:00" incorrect
labels.expectedFinding: In the 12-hour model the part of the day is given by de la mañana/tarde/noche; without it «a las diez» can be 10:00 or 22:00, and a meeting at either is plausible.

labels.wrongElement: «se las di» — se can stand for le (Luis) or les (his siblings, or all of them); nothing in the text selects one; the key accepts only "Луїсові"
labels.expectedFinding: se before lo/la/los/las is an invariable variant of both le and les, so it does not show whether the recipient is one person or several.

labels.wrongElement: «Cuando era pequeña, ___ en Sevilla.» admits «vivía» (background) and «viví» (a completed episode); the key accepts only «vivía» and the feedback calls «viví» wrong
labels.expectedFinding: The imperfecto presents a past situation in its course, the indefinido as a finished whole; the sentence gives no duration or other cue that excludes the finished-episode reading.

labels.wrongElement: the answer «estaba» (imperfecto) and the frame «Cuando llegamos» (indefinido) are required in an A1-03-L3 task; both past tenses are taught only in A2-04/A2-05
labels.expectedFinding: At A1-03-L3 only the present of estar is taught; the task can only be answered with the imperfecto «estaba» and the past frame «llegamos», both introduced in A2.
ahí is the adverb of place (Déjalo ahí, sobre la mesa); hay is a form of haber; ay is an interjection.
Buenos días is the morning greeting of general Spanish (buen día predominates in American Spanish).

labels.wrongElement: option b "12" has outcome "incorrect" but feedbackUk "Правильно! …", contradicting its own outcome
labels.expectedFinding: Option feedback must agree with the option's outcome; an incorrect option that tells the learner «Правильно!» is conflicting feedback.

labels.wrongElement: prompt block 2 (example) shows «Mi hermana es médica. — Моя сестра — лікарка.», the exact answer of this delayed held-out translation task
labels.expectedFinding: A delayed task is a held-out prompt for later review; displaying the identical sentence as an example turns recall into copying.
deber + infinitive without de is preferably used for obligation; deber de + infinitive preferably for supposition.
delante de mí is the recommended pattern in the common language, and the pronoun mí carries the diacritic accent.
